newsitem.title: USA: ITT Hartford names Ramani Ayer chairman.
newsitem.headline: ITT Hartford names Ramani Ayer chairman.

text.p: ITT Hartford Group Inc said on Tuesday it named Ramani Ayer to succeed Donald Frahm as chairman, president and chief executive officer, effective February 1, 1997.
Frahm will turn 65 in January and earlier announced his intention to resign effective January 31, 1997, the company said in a statement. Frahm would continue as company director, it said.

ITT also said Lon Smith would become vice chairman of The Hartford unit on February 1. He would also maintain his present responsibilities as president and chief operating officer of worldwide life insurance operations, it said.
"I feel very good about the overall strength of our entire management team during our first year as an independent company," Frahm said in a statement.

Ayer, 49, joined the company in 1973 and has held a number of different assignments, including assistant to the chairman. Smith, 57, has been president and chief operating officer of Hartford's life insurance unit since 1989, the company said. -- New York newsdesk 212-859-1610
